name: Manalath
author: Dieter Stein & Néstor Romeral Andrés (2012) — AGP port
description: Dieter Stein & Néstor Romeral Andrés's "simply difficult" game on a hexagon of hexagons (side 5, 61 cells). Each turn you place a stone of EITHER colour, and no placement may build a group of more than five. Finish your turn with a group of exactly five of your own colour and you win; finish it with a group of exactly four of your own colour and you lose — so both players are constantly building for and against both colours.
